title: Custom instructions for ChatGPT
summary: We’re rolling out custom instructions to give you more control over how ChatGPT responds. Set your preferences, and ChatGPT will keep them in mind for all future conversations.
body: We’re rolling out custom instructions to give you more control over how ChatGPT responds. Set your preferences, and ChatGPT will keep them in mind for all future conversations.
summaryZh: OpenAI为ChatGPT推出了自定义指令功能，允许用户设置偏好，以便在未来的所有对话中保持这些设定。
